_comment: Written by the Security Review persona. The pre-tag CI job reads this to decide whether a release is covered by a current audit. Do not hand-edit.
open_findings: MEDIUM #96: durable audit trail — direction set (B+C), documentation deliverable deliberately sequenced after #101
LOW #98: note direction / echo-suppression relies on company-name matching
notes: Delta review covering #115 (release note now states why the gate flagged, rather than asserting 'no audit' for every flag reason).

SELF-REVIEWED: same session authored and reviewed. Evidence is reproducible — three note states rendered and exited cleanly under bash -e (including the empty-note case, which a short-circuit bug would have broken); four-way COVERED/FINDINGS matrix classified correctly; the fix reproduces by hand the note v1.0.47 should have carried.

Third gate defect found and closed (#108, #109, #115). Common shape: the tooling reported a state it had not established. All three were caught by verifying output rather than trusting that a step succeeded.
Remaining mechanical warning is the known v1-endpoint usage sunsetting 2027-01-01 (#101).

NOT re-probed this session: inbound webhook ingress authentication (relying on the closed #90 disposition). SRI-vs-CDN and release-environment reviewer checks are point-in-time from the 96815ac review.
